hookups.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('Camping is primitive, temporary and dispersed. There are no established campsites and no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations).'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ ('no amenities (electric, potable water, dump stations, restrooms, convenience stations)'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camping on a Virginia WMA needs a written camping authorization ($10, up to six people) from Go Outdoors Virginia or a license agent, which sets the trip's start and end dates; 14 nights at most. Only in previously cleared spots, and 'unlawful to camp within 300 feet of any lake or facility'. DWR: 'WMA roads are not suitable for long vehicles or trailers ... Some WMAs may not allow travel trailers or RVs.' Rapidan: 'Primitive camping (no developed sites or facilities) is permitted throughout the management area'. DWR says Rapidan's WMA roads, and the roads leading to it beyond state maintenance, 'are narrow and not maintained to VDOT standards and can be rough. A four-wheel drive vehicle recommended.'

booking.source: https://dwr.virginia.gov/camping-on-wmas/ + https://dwr.virginia.gov/wma/rapidan/ (Other Activities; Maps & Directions), read 2026-10-21
